_comment: Expectation template for dbcheck.py verify. Copy it next to the run that produced the data
and fill in real values. All timestamps are UTC (the same text the DB stores).
Typical flow for one acceptance step:
1. capture a bound:  python dbcheck.py snapshot <db>   -> note ts_max_utc (or use now-UTC)
2. drive the UI / perform the physical action
3. copy app.db off the cabinet (app.db + -wal + -shm while it is running)
Rule of thumb (口径优化 2026-10-09): one human action = one record; door open/close and
clearing are FIELDS on that record. Standalone door events only when no business record results.
